title: Compare values
objective: Compare two values with is equal to, is greater than, is at least and the other comparison phrases.

body.text: A comparison asks whether a statement about two values is true. It gives true or false, and if uses that answer. Lagom writes comparisons as phrases: is equal to, is not equal to, is greater than, is less than, is at least and is at most.

body.title: Greater than and less than
body.code:
make age equal to 15
if age is greater than 13
    say "teenager or older"
make score equal to 40
if score is less than 50
    say "keep practicing"

body.text: at least means greater than or equal to. at most means less than or equal to. Use them when the boundary value should count as a pass.

body.title: At least and at most
body.code:
make score equal to 80
if score is at least 80
    say "passing"
make temperature equal to -2
if temperature is at most 0
    say "freezing"

body.text: is equal to checks for the same value, and is not equal to checks for a different one. Use is equal to, not a single equals sign, to compare.

body.title: Equal and not equal
body.code:
make name equal to "Ada"
if name is not equal to ""
    say "a name was entered"
make answer equal to 42
if answer is equal to 42
    say "correct"

body.prompt: A score of exactly 80 should also pass, but the program prints nothing at all for it. Make it print passing.
body.starter:
make score equal to 80
if score is greater than 80
    say "passing"
body.solution:
make score equal to 80
if score is at least 80
    say "passing"

checks.description: The check uses is at least 80
